title: ALFWorld is executable, but paper training still awaits admission gates
decision: Run three bounded ALFWorld collection-replay gates and recover only the two scheduler-pending model process gates on Gruenau.
plain_summary: All four model pathways now pass their process gates; official ALFWorld collection, counterfactual branching, and non-oracle interactive replay pass smoke and unseen recovery checks, while full model sweeps remain blocked on dataset admission.
